description: The application shell: navigation and a scrolling main, in one of four arrangements. Routing-agnostic — pass any nav in the `nav` slot. Below the drawer breakpoint a side arrangement becomes an overlay drawer toggled by `navOpen`; `top` and `none` have nothing to drawer and stay as they are.

props.name: nav
props.description: The navigation (e.g. a <SideNav/>). Ignored when `layout` is "none".

props.name: arrangement
props.description: How the shell is arranged: where the navigation sits, and whether it is attached to the content or detached from it.

props.name: navOpen
props.description: Mobile only: whether the nav drawer is open.

props.name: onNavClose
props.description: Mobile only: called when the backdrop is clicked.

props.name: onNavOpen
props.description: Mobile only, and REQUIRED when `navOpen` is passed: what the drawer button in the header calls. A controlled shell with no way to open is a phone with no navigation, which is the failure <NavDrawerButton> exists to prevent.
